definitions.short: Chelam , a place East of Palestine
definitions.full: H2431. Chelam חֵילָם proper name, of a location east of Jordan 2Sam 10:16 (Th their army , but ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Ew Geschichte. iii. 211 Anm. 1 = H iii. 155 n. 2 We Dr) = חֵלָ֑א֯מָה 10:17 ( ᵐ5 Αιλαμ ); + חילם Ezek 47:16 ( ᵐ5 Ηλιαμ ) Co; according to this it lay on the border between Damascus and Hamath.
definitions.rootNote: or חֵלָאם xlit Chêlʼâm corrected to Chêlâʼm ; from 2428 ; fortress ;

occurrences.englishText: Hadadezer sent, and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River: and they came to Helam, with Shobach the captain of the army of Hadadezer at their head.
David was told that; and he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, and came to Helam. The Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.
